metadata.title: Upwork Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Specification & Automation Manual
metadata.target_use_case: Autonomous Job Discovery, Client Intelligence & Automated Proposal Drafting

architecture.description: The Upwork MCP Server serves as a direct bridge between autonomous AI agents and the Upwork freelance marketplace. It enforces a two-phase "Draft-and-Confirm" pattern to safeguard freelancer Connects balances, prevent platform spam, and ensure full compliance with Upwork Terms of Service.

context_resolution.step: Enumerate available accounts across Freelancer, Client, and Agency personas.
Obtain the specific organization identifier (org_uid). Every subsequent tool invocation requires this org_uid.

safety_governance.principle: All state-modifying actions (proposals, postings, milestone submissions, profile edits) generate an ephemeral server-side preview with a unique preview_id. No change is made live until upwork__confirm_preview is called with that preview_id.
AI agents are strictly prohibited from confirming proposals without presenting Connects costs, bid amounts, and full draft copy to the human operator.
Accepting contract offers (respond_to_offer action=accept) cannot be finalized via MCP. It returns a finalize_url requiring human cryptographic signature on upwork.com.
The tool requires explicit policy acknowledgment before facilitating direct client negotiations.

job_proposal_automation_engine.overview: Designed specifically for freelancers seeking to automate the discovery of newly posted, high-converting marketplace jobs and prepare ready-to-confirm proposals.

configuration.param: Accesses the personalized recommendation feed ranked in reverse chronological order.
Enforces a strict 24-hour publication window ("posted today"). Note: smart_search is the ONLY endpoint supporting real date filtering.
Eliminates unverified spam accounts and payment fraud risks.
Standard pagination size. Subsequent pages retrieved using the next_cursor token.

alternative_search_tool.description: Use for exact keyword or role targeting across the entire marketplace.
alternative_search_tool.best_practice: Prefer title parameter over query (e.g., title="Fullstack Python") to avoid semantic expansion noise. Title words are strictly ANDed and stemmed.
alternative_search_tool.proposals_filter: Target jobs with fewer than 10 submissions before competition intensifies.

rate_overlap_logic.rate_min: Matches jobs where posted budget maximum is greater than or equal to rate_min.
rate_overlap_logic.rate_max: Matches jobs where posted budget minimum is less than or equal to rate_max.

field.name: client_record
field.attribute: Lifetime platform spend. Benchmark: prefer > $1,000 USD.
Hiring velocity. Benchmark: prefer > 50% hire rate.
Freelancers' aggregate review score of the client (1.0 to 5.0). Flag ratings below 4.6.

field.name: activityStat.jobActivity
field.attribute: If > 0 for a single-seat job, the role is filled. Discard immediately.
Pending offers. High values indicate advanced client decision stages.

field.name: client_feedback
field.description: Up to 5 recent reviews left by other freelancers. Automation engines should extract named contacts (e.g. 'Sarah was amazing') to personalize cover letters directly without guesswork.

field.name: preferred_qualifications
field.description: Inspect English proficiency, Job Success Score (JSS), location bounds, and talent badges.

payload_analysis.field: Exact number of Connects debited upon submission.
Boolean check. If true, agent must abort proposal flow.

stage.name: pre_submission_conflict_check
stage.critical_rule: Invoking manage_proposals action=create when an invitation or previous proposal already exists triggers error VJ-JA-10. The agent MUST perform the following validations before drafting:

validation_call.condition: If invitation exists for target jobPosting.id, ABORT action=create and route to action=accept_invitation.
If proposal already exists with status Pending/Accepted, ABORT.

input_schema_mapping.param: Numeric job ID from search results (NOT the ~02... ciphertext).
Proposed hourly rate or fixed price project fee.
Tailored, authentic cover letter referencing specific client requirements, named contacts from feedback, and relevant past project deliveries.
Required when job carries screening_questions. Array of { question, answer } objects.
Project IDs fetched via upwork__get_profile action=list_highlights.
Certificate IDs fetched via upwork__get_profile action=list_highlights.
Connects bid for paid ranking slot. Must adhere to boost auction dynamics.

boost_auction_rules.rule: Must be greater than or equal to preview.boost.recommended_connects.
Cannot exceed preview.boost.max_boost_connects (connects_balance minus proposal connects_cost).
Do not boost if preview.boost.recommendation is 'skip' or boost.available is false.

stage.name: human_confirmation_and_execution
stage.behavior: The MCP server loads all previously staged parameters from internal server storage. Upon successful execution, proposal status changes to 'Pending' / 'Accepted' (submitted and validated).

error.name: Proposal Conflict Error
error.trigger: Calling manage_proposals action=create when an invitation or proposal already exists.
error.resolution: Call list_freelancer_proposals action=invitations first; use accept_invitation if invitation is present.

error.name: Strict Taxonomy Rejection
error.trigger: Supplying non-canonical string in timezone or location filters.
error.resolution: Inspect response filters_rejected object to extract accepted canonical spelling and retry.

error.name: Unmatched Skill Filter
error.trigger: Supplying a skill name that does not exist in Upwork's ontology.
error.resolution: Inspect response filters_ignored. If all skills were ignored, broaden terms or use query parameter.

error.name: Insufficient Boost Bid
error.resolution: Set boost_connects >= recommended_connects or omit boosting entirely.
